Therefore, the events of "The Last Battle" must have taken place in [[2 BBY]]. I am unit B1-268. My commander has sent me to report your intentions.|B1-268, to Imperial stormtroopers|}} '''B1-268''' was an [[OOM command battle droid]] who was a part of the [[Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. After the war's end, B1-268 resided in the wreckage of a [[Unidentified DH-Omni Support Vessel (Agamar)|downed]] [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel|Separatist supply ship]] on the [[planet]] [[Agamar]], along with [[ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|super tactical droid]] [[general]] [[Kalani]] and [[Agamar garrison|many other]] [[battle droid]]s. During the [[Galactic Civil War]], B1-268 and [[Separatist holdouts|several]] [[B1-series battle droid]]s apprehended members of the [[Phoenix Cell]], who had [[Mission to Agamar (2 BBY)|come]] to Agamar in search of munitions. Giving them no other option, Kalani forced the rebels to engage the droids in the "last battle" of the Clone Wars. Once the battle came to an end, the [[Galactic Empire]] arrived on the planet after tracing a rebel transmission there, and B1-268 was sent to discover why the Empire had come. Upon encountering the Imperial [[stormtrooper]]s, however, he was destroyed. ==Biography== ===Construction and Clone Wars=== {{Quote|The Jedi betrayal ended the war for most of the galaxy. But here on Agamar, I assumed it was a Republic trick and prevented the shutdown command.|Kalani, B1-268's commander, on why his droids were still operating|}} B1-268 was an [[OOM command battle droid]] manufactured by [[Baktoid Combat Automata]] and [[Baktoid Armor Workshop]] to serve the [[Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars]], an [[The galaxy|intergalactic]] conflict which pitted the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] against the [[Galactic Republic]]. The Confederacy wished to secede from the Republic, believing it to be a corrupt institution,{{Film|II}} and waged war throughout the [[galaxy]] against the Republic,{{Film|III}} battling against their [[Grand Army of the Republic|army]] of [[Clone trooper|clone soldiers]]. Near the war's end, [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] of the Republic—who was, in truth, the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth]] Sidious, secret leader of the Separatists—issued [[Order 66|Clone Protocol 66]], which branded the [[The Force|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive|wielding]] [[Jedi]] of the Republic as [[Treason|traitors]] and resulted in the [[Great Jedi Purge|destruction]] of the [[Jedi Order]]. Sidious gave a [[Proclamation of the New Order|speech]] to the [[Galactic Senate]], proclaiming the Jedi were traitors and declaring that the Republic would be transformed into the First [[Galactic Empire]]. Whilst Sidious gave his speech, his new [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], [[Mission to Mustafar|slaughtered]] the remaining [[Executive Separatist Council|Separatist leaders]] in their [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility|compound]] on the [[planet]] [[Mustafar]]. Vader contacted Sidious, who instructed him to send a transmission ordering that all remaining [[battle droid]]s be deactivated. [[Kalani]], a [[ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|super tactical droid]] who served as a [[general]] in the [[Droid]] [[Army]] and was B1-268's [[commander]], received the message on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]][[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] world of [[Agamar]]. However, Kalani assumed it was a trick by the Republic, so he did not shut down his forces. ===Rebels on Agamar=== {{Quote|We have new orders, incapacitate and capture. Activating stunner.|B1-268 apprehends the intruders|}} With the Clone War over and the Separatist Alliance dissolved, B1-268 and his [[Agamar garrison|fellow droids]] resided in the remains of a [[Unidentified DH-Omni Support Vessel (Agamar)|downed]] [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel|Separatist supply ship]] on Agamar. In the [[Standard year|year]] [[2 BBY]], seventeen years after the war's end, [[Spectres|members]] of a rebel movement against the Empire entered the supply [[Starship|ship]] in [[Mission to Agamar (2 BBY)|search]] of munitions. After locating the ship's munitions depot, the rebels were caught in a [[ray shield]] and quickly surrounded by B1-268 and five B1 battle droids. B1-268, believing the intruders were a part of the Galactic Republic, instructed his [[Separatist holdouts|troops]] to prepare to shoot them; however, he received new orders saying that the invaders were to instead be brought to the ship's command center. B1-268 commented on how it was his first time capturing enemies, so he and his droids [[stun]]ned them before dragging the [[prisoner]]s back to the center. [[File:Ray_shielded_rebels_stunned.png|thumb|left|250px|B1-268 stuns the intruders.]] After bringing the rebels to the command center, B1-268 reported in with General Kalani, who congratulated the droid on accomplishing his task. Kalani spoke with the prisoners, two of whom were Jedi, [[Rex|one]] of whom was a [[Captain]], and [[Garazeb Orrelios|one]] of whom was a [[Lasat]] [[Lasan High Honor Guard|guardsman]]. Kalani, wishing to end the Clone Wars once and for all with a Separatist victory, proposed that one last battle take place in which his forces hold the Lasat hostage while the Jedi and [[Cloning|clone]] battled his droids to rescue him. Facing the threat of termination if they did not comply, they accepted the [[tactical droid]]'s terms and left the ship while Kalani's forces [[Battle Plan Zeta|moved into position]]. After defeating the first wave of droids and making their way to the [[hangar]], the rebels were caught off guard by [[droideka]]s from the catwalk above and forced to take cover. While the rebels devised a plan to defeat the droids, B1-268 moved in on their position along with several B1 battle droids. The rebels managed to initiate their plan, however: one of the Jedi, [[Ezra Bridger]], used the Force to ram a crane into the catwalk, causing the droidekas to fall down onto B1-268's forces below. B1-268 managed to avoid being crushed, however, and the rebels passed by him as they continued making their way to the command center. The rebels secured the command center, thus ending the battle. However, the Empire had intercepted a [[distress signal]] transmitted by a rebel [[astromech droid]] that had evaded capture by the battle droids, [[C1-10P]], and had responded by sending [[soldier]]s to Agamar. Kalani ordered B1-268 to investigate, and the droid approached the incoming [[Sentinel-class landing craft|shuttles]] along with three other battle droids. B1-268 greeted the [[stormtrooper]]s, informing them that he was sent to ascertain what the Empire was doing on the planet. His words went ignored, as Imperial protocol dictated that any "clankers" (battle droids) were to be shot on sight. And so he was shot by one of the stormtroopers. ==Characteristics== {{Quote|How intriguing. Well done, B1-268.''"
"''Roger, roger.|Kalani and B1-268, after the latter's capture of the rebels|}} B1-268 showed great loyalty to the Separatist cause, informing the rebels he and his droids caught that they were in Separatist custody, despite it being over a [[Standard decade|decade]] after the Confederacy's dissolution. Quick to follow orders, B1-268 did not hesitate to alter his objective from killing the intruders on Agamar to stunning and capturing them, nor did he back down from hazardous situations, marching head-on with his fellow droids at the rebels in the supply ship's hangar. Like B1 and other OOM command battle droids, B1-268 stood at 1.93 [[meter]]s tall and was created for the purpose of engaging in combat. B1-268 sported several [[Color|yellow]] markings, indicating him as a command droid. Unlike most standard and command battle droids, however, B1-268 lacked a [[comlink booster pack]]. B1-268 was armed with an [[E-5 blaster rifle]], the standard weapon of most battle droids, and would stow it on his backside when not using it. Due to not receiving any maintenance after the Clone War's conclusion, various scratches and scorch marks could be seen on B1-268's plating. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|At first he was going to be called "Roger," but the ''LEGO Freemaker Adventures'' beat us to the joke!|Steven Melching, on nicknaming B1-268|{{Twitter|stevenmelching|status/790715233824153600|[[Steven Melching]]|quote=At first he was going to be called "Roger," but the Lego #FreemakerAdventures beat us to the joke! #StarWarsRebels #BattleDroidHumor|archivefile=File:Melching B1-268 Roger tweet.png}}}} [[File:B1-268_concept_art.png|thumb|250px|Concept art of B1-268.]] B1-268 appeared in the sixth episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''{{'}} [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third season]], "[[The Last Battle]],"{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/the-last-battle-episode-guide|text="The Last Battle" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} which aired on [[October 22]], [[2016]], on [[Disney XD]].{{WebCite|url=http://tvlistings.zap2it.com/tv/star-wars-rebels-the-last-battle/EP018796240061|text=Star Wars Rebels : ''The Last Battle''|work=[http://tvlistings.zap2it.com Screener]|archivedate=20170130015734}} B1-268 was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]], who voiced the battle droids in [[Lucasfilm Animation]]'s previous television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.{{TCW|Ambush}} The battle droid was named by [[Steven Melching]], who is credited as [[Wikipedia:Story editor|story editor]] in "The Last Battle," after his birthday.{{Twitter|stevenmelching|status/790343644498624512|[[Steven Melching]]|quote=My favorite scene in this week's #StarWarsRebels. I couldn't stop laughing. (Trivia: I named B1-268 after my birthday, lol.)|archivefile=File:Melching B1-268 birthday tweet.png}} In the original outline for "The Last Battle," Ezra Bridger would've befriended B1-268{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/the-last-battle-trivia-gallery|text="The Last Battle" Trivia Gallery}}, image 5 of 6 and nicknamed him "Roger," though this idea was dismissed as the animated series ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures]]'' features a B1 battle droid named [[R0-GR/LEGO|Roger]].{{SW|url=news/lego-star-wars-the-freemaker-adventures-premieres-june-20-on-disney-xd|text=''LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures'' Premieres June 20 on Disney XD}} B1-268's nickname was then changed to "Clanky," however the idea of Bridger nicknaming the droid was cut from the episode early in production. The ''Star Wars Rebels'' staff considered having B1-268 become a member of the ''[[Ghost]]'' crew, but this was decided against due to them believing there were already too many crew members and there wasn't enough room for another.{{Twitter|stevenmelching|status/790993686423142400|[[Steven Melching]]|quote=@BlueJaigEyes This idea was discussed at the story break! Ultimately we decided we already had too many crew members to add another.|archivefile=File:Melching B1-268 Crew tweet.png}} ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|The Last Battle}} {{1st}} ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of B1-268}} *{{SWYouTube|eCsUudYwOvY|Revenge of the Droid Army - The Last Battle Preview | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/star-wars-rebels-revenge-of-the-droid-army}} *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/the-last-battle-episode-guide|text="The Last Battle" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} *{{BuildR2Cite|30|Droid Directory}} *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=B1-268 |nl=B1-268 |pl=B1-268 }} [[Category:Droids of the Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Category:Droids with masculine programming]] [[Category:OOM command battle droids]] [[Category:Separatist holdouts individuals]] [[Category:Separatist officers]]
